original: WPRPLACE is a national park in east-central Poland, in Masovian Voivodeship, on the northwest outskirts of Warsaw. It is Poland's second-largest national park by area and the only national park in the Masovian Voivodeship. It has a sister park agreement with Indiana Dunes National Park, Indiana, United States.
translated: WPRPLACE ist ein Nationalpark im östlichen Zentralpolen, in der masovischen Woiwodschaft, am nordwestlichen Stadtrand von Warschau.
